tour.title: Agent Boot & Project Identity
tour.description: Start at AGENT_BOOT.md, the Level 1 Twin Shell entry point for the Owen County Schools Upgrades & Athletics project (#3620251). It establishes the project identity, the non-inheritance rule that blocks UK CAER facts from leaking into this twin, the six-rank authority stack, and the required read order for the next agent. This is the doctrine entry point: every other shell document is reached from here.
tour.languageLesson: Markdown shell docs use YAML frontmatter to carry TCS twin metadata (id, project, twin_level, status, authority_boundary). The frontmatter is machine-readable while the body stays human-readable.

tour.title: Altitude Mesh Operating System
tour.description: The doctrine that AGENT_BOOT.md points to. DOCTRINE__ALTITUDE_MESH_OPERATING_SYSTEM.md defines the six-layer signal stack (Subatomic, Micro, Meso, Macro, VP/Exec Rollup, Founder), the Upward Reporting Law, the Upward-Wake Gate, and the cadence schedule (continuous, 15min, 60min, cleanpoint edges, twice-daily, weekly, immediate). Every report and order in the Owen County twin travels through this mesh.

tour.title: Source Map & Authority Stack
tour.description: SOURCE_MAP.md registers every input the shell reads. It pins the live OneDrive project folder pointer, lists the original folder source map (folders 1-18 plus Issues, HERMES_INBOX, TCS_OVERLAY), names the system-of-record candidates per lane (contract, Sage, Submittal Exchange, RFIs, schedule, safety/QC, correspondence, PM actions), and explicitly enumerates missing source evidence. This is where source-currentness work orders originate.

tour.title: Twin State & Validation Queue
tour.description: TWIN_STATE.md is the digital-twin ledger built on the sources from Step 3. It records Level 1 readiness, project identity rows with fact states, registered twin object families (Project, ProjectGate, ProjectTwinState, Zone, EvidenceToken, ApprovalBoundary, ActionRecord, RiskRecord), and the seed validation queue OWEN-VQ-001..009 covering submittal/RFI conflicts, overdue checklists, CO/CPR split, safety evidence gaps, DPO reconciliation, schedule freshness, PM transition, and stale cleanpoints.

tour.title: Gate Readiness & Stop Rules
tour.description: GATE_READINESS.md is the approval-boundary control plane. It enumerates the A0-D2 gate matrix with current state, blocker, and required evidence; codifies the stop-rule split between what the agent may do unilaterally versus what requires Michael's approval; defines the canonical validation states (cited, inferred, validated, disputed, stale, superseded, not_authority); and supplies the receipt template required for any gate movement. Together with Step 4, this enforces the review-only posture.

tour.title: Wiki Schema & Catalog
tour.description: The Understand-Anything treatment layer begins with the wiki SCHEMA.md (authoring conventions, YAML frontmatter format, tag taxonomy, page-creation thresholds, entity/concept page templates) and the index.md catalog that links every entity, concept, comparison, and query page. These two files define how the shell documents from Steps 1-5 get reprojected as a browsable knowledge graph.
tour.languageLesson: Wiki pages use [[wikilinks]] for cross-references and YAML frontmatter for typed metadata. The schema enforces consistent tag taxonomy so entity/concept/comparison/query pages can be queried as a structured graph rather than a loose document pile.

tour.title: Owen County Entity Page
tour.description: owen-county.md is the central entity page in the wiki, describing the Owen County construction project, its use of the Altitude Mesh Operating System from Step 2, and its relationships to the agent boot, gate readiness, source map, and twin state documents from Steps 1, 3, 4, and 5. This is the wiki's single best landing page for an agent or human who wants the project at a glance.

tour.title: Doctrine & Agent Boot Entity Pages
tour.description: Capstone: the altitude-mesh.md and agent-boot.md wiki entity pages reproject Steps 1 and 2 into the knowledge graph. altitude-mesh.md documents the governing framework's layered architecture (Doctrine/Agent/Gate/Execution/Feedback), while agent-boot.md describes the initialization sequence and its relationship to the governing doctrine. With these in place, the full Level 1 Twin Shell is browsable end-to-end.
